verses.text: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?

xrefs.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness. Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

verses.text: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

xrefs.text: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.

verses.text: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.

xrefs.text: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.

verses.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.

xrefs.text: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

verses.text: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.

verses.text: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

verses.text: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.

xrefs.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

verses.text: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

xrefs.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

verses.text: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.

xrefs.text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
“Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.
Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

verses.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

xrefs.text: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!
He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
“Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.

verses.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

xrefs.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

verses.text: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

xrefs.text: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.

verses.text: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

xrefs.text: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

verses.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!

xrefs.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
